name: Fenris Ballistics Howl Grenade HG-2 'Banshee'
description:
A throwable sonic device that produces a focused acoustic blast exceeding 190 decibels within a 10-meter radius. The Banshee generates its acoustic output through rapid piezoelectric expansion of a crystalline core, converting stored electrical energy into a single devastating sound pulse that ruptures eardrums, fractures sinus cavities, and can cause fatal pulmonary hemorrhage in targets within 3 meters.

Fenris Ballistics designed the Banshee as an area-denial weapon that bridges the gap between flashbang grenades and lethal fragmentation. The device is activated by a standard grenade fuze with a 2-second delay, and the acoustic pulse propagates omnidirectionally from the crystalline core. The sound wave reflects off hard surfaces in enclosed spaces, creating interference patterns that amplify the effect in corridors and rooms.

Unlike conventional grenades, the Banshee produces no fragmentation and leaves no blast damage to structures. The only evidence of its use is organic — ruptured eardrums, hemorrhaged lungs, and the shattered crystalline core of the device itself.
legality: Licensed — military and corporate tactical units
specifications:
caliber: N/A — throwable sonic device
effective_range: 10-meter lethal radius, 30-meter incapacitation radius
rate_of_fire: N/A — single-use throwable
capacity: N/A — single device
weight: 0.4 kg
power_source: Internal piezoelectric capacitor, pre-charged
tactical_use: The Banshee is deployed for room clearing, corridor denial, and area incapacitation where fragmentation grenades would cause unacceptable structural damage. The device is thrown into enclosed spaces where acoustic reflection amplifies its effect, and the 2-second delay allows the operator to clear the blast radius. In open environments, the Banshee's effectiveness decreases rapidly with distance, but in the enclosed spaces that define most urban combat, it is devastating.
cultural_context: The Banshee has earned a reputation as one of the most feared non-fragmentation weapons in GLMZ. Survivors describe the experience as 'being hit by sound' — a physical force that penetrates cover, passes through walls, and attacks the body from inside. Hearing loss from Banshee exposure is permanent and untreatable by conventional means, creating a growing population of combat-deafened veterans who carry the device's signature injury.
story_hooks: A modified Banshee was detonated in a subway station during rush hour. The acoustic pulse, amplified by the tunnel system, caused hearing damage in over 300 commuters and killed four people near the device. The perpetrator left no note and no demand.

Fenris is developing a directional Banshee variant that focuses the acoustic pulse into a 30-degree cone rather than an omnidirectional blast. The prototype turns a room-clearing device into a precision acoustic weapon.

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, egg-shaped device with a subtly asymmetrical form. The visible crystalline core dominates the center, casting prismatic refractions under light. The outer shell has a smooth, almost organic curvature that belies its lethal purpose. Looks like a high-tech geological specimen rather than a weapon.
physical_description.dimensions: 7.2 cm height, 5.8 cm width, 5.1 cm depth. Compact enough to fit in a closed fist.
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively substantial for its size — 0.4 kg gives it a dense, concentrated heft. Feels engineered rather than light.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade polymer shell surrounding a piezoelectric crystalline core matrix. Inner acoustic chamber lined with metamaterial sound-focusing geometry.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal polymer exterior with a subtle anti-reflective coating. The crystalline core visible through semi-transparent polymer panels exhibits sharp, geometric faceting with a faint iridescent shimmer when backlit.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal black primary with deep indigo and violet iridescence in the visible crystalline sections. Minimal accent markings in phosphorescent green for activation status.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured polymer grip surface with shallow diamond-pattern knurling for secure handling with either bare or gloved hands. Non-slip even when wet.
distinctive_features: Exposed piezoelectric crystalline core visible through translucent polymer panels — the heart of the weapon
Faint luminescent green activation indicator on one hemisphere that glows when internally charged
Subtle directional vanes molded into the base for throw aerodynamics
Micro-etched serial number and tier-rating stamps on the mounting plate
Hairline fractures visible in the crystalline matrix of used units — evidence of previous acoustic pulse
Minimal fuze housing flush-mounted to prevent snagging
Faint concentric rings molded into the shell — acoustic resonance guides
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: FENRIS BALLISTICS logo stamped in matte silver on the upper hemisphere. Model designation 'HG-2' laser-etched below. Banshee codename and tier rating (T3+) printed in phosphorescent green on the lower mounting plate. Serial number runs across the base in micro-print.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine units show mirror-smooth polymer finish and unblemished crystalline core. Field-used units exhibit micro-fractures in the crystalline matrix, scuff marks on the polymer, and often show discoloration from residue exposure. Post-deployment units are frequently discarded and replaced entirely.
